content.comment_body: Hello to everyone reading. After setting up IoT objects, certificates, policies, environment, etc. on AWS cloud and verifying that everything works correctly, I would appreciate help understanding why, when I upload a project using [product_name] to AWS cloud, the project is successfully deposited, but when I try to open the generated [url], I consistently receive an error: 'HTTP 404 - Not Found. The origin server did not find a current representation for the target resource or is not willing to disclose that one exists. Apache Tomcat/10.1.13.' Thank you in advance for any helpful information. [user_name]

Hello [user_name], We kindly ask you to discuss your question in English, as this is an international community focused on a single language. Posting in English will help you get more responses to your question. Here is the translation of your question: Regards, [user_name]_Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: A user shared that their project upload from [product_name] to AWS Cloud was successful, but attempts to access the generated web address resulted in a persistent HTTP 404 error. While deployment appears correct, the web application remains inaccessible, causing confusion and halting the user's workflow.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that uploading a project to AWS via [product_name] will result in an accessible and functioning web resource at the provided web address.
